say: How do I hard boil an egg?
text: To hard boil an egg, start by bringing water to a rolling boil in a pot. Add cold water to the pot, then place eggs in a single layer in the water. Cook for about 9 to 12 minutes, then cool in ice water before peeling.

say: How do I get a red wine stain out of a shirt?
text: To remove a red wine stain from a shirt, first blot the stain gently with a clean cloth or paper towel to soak up the excess wine. Then, mix one part white vinegar with one part cold water, apply it to the stain, and let it sit for a few minutes before gently rubbing it with a soft brush or cloth. Finally, wash the shirt in cold water with your regular detergent.

say: How do I unclog a drain without chemicals?
text: To unclog a drain without chemicals, start by using a plunger to create suction and remove blockages. If that doesn’t work, try a drain snake or a wire hanger bent into a loop to fish out hair or debris. For stubborn clogs, boiling water or a mixture of baking soda and vinegar can help break down the buildup.

say: How long should I cook spaghetti?

say: What's a good way to fall asleep faster?
text: Winding down with a calming activity like reading or listening to soft music can help. Try avoiding screens before bed, as blue light can make it harder to fall asleep. Keeping your bedroom cool and dark also makes it easier to drift off.

say: How do I jump start a car?
text: To jump-start a car, you need to connect the positive (red) cables from the dead battery to the good battery first, then connect the negative (black) cables to the car chassis of both cars. Make sure the engines are off and the batteries are not touching. Then start the good car’s engine to recharge the dead battery.

say: How do I convert Celsius to Fahrenheit?
text: To convert Celsius to Fahrenheit, multiply the temperature by 9/5 and then add 32. For example, 25°C is about 77°F.

say: How often should I water a cactus?
text: Cactus plants usually only need water about once every two to three weeks, depending on the size and type. Let the soil dry out completely between waterings to avoid overwatering. In hot weather, you might need to water slightly more often.

say: How do I take a screenshot on an Android phone?
text: To take a screenshot on an Android phone, press the power button and the volume down button at the same time, then hold them for a few seconds. The screenshot will be saved automatically in your gallery.

say: How do I cook rice on the stove?
text: To cook rice on the stove, first rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Then, use a ratio of 1 part rice to 2 parts water, bring it to a boil, cover with a tight lid, and simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes. Let it sit off heat for a few minutes before fluffing with a fork.

say: What should I do if I burn my finger on the stove?
text: First, let the burned skin cool by running your finger under cool, running water for about 5 minutes. Then, gently clean the area with mild soap and water to keep it clean.

say: How do I clean a cast iron pan?
text: To clean a cast iron pan, first let it cool completely. Scrub it with a stiff brush or non-abrasive sponge using warm water and a little soap. Dry it thoroughly on the stove over medium heat and store it upside down to prevent rust.

say: How do I get rid of hiccups?
text: Hiccups usually go away on their own after a few minutes. If they last a long time or keep coming back, you might try drinking water slowly or sucking on a lemon wedge. If they don’t stop, see a doctor.

say: How can I make my phone battery last longer?
text: To make your phone battery last longer, try reducing screen brightness, closing apps you’re not using, and charging it properly—don’t keep it at 100% overnight. Also, avoid extreme temperatures and enable battery-saving modes when needed.

say: How do I get a stripped screw out?
text: To get a stripped screw out, you can try using a screwdriver with a sharp point and a bit of lubricant like penetrating oil. If that doesn’t work, you might need a special tool like a screw extractor or carefully tap a new one in place. If the screw is very deep, you may need to cut off the head first.

say: How long should a steak rest after cooking?
text: A steak should rest for about 5 to 10 minutes after cooking to let the juices redistribute inside. This helps keep it juicy when you cut into it.

say: How do I work out a 20 percent tip?
text: To calculate a 20 percent tip, take the total bill amount and multiply it by 0.20. For example, if the bill is $50, add $10 to it for a 20 percent tip.

say: How do I keep a cut avocado from turning brown?
text: To keep a cut avocado from turning brown, you can place the cut piece in a bowl of cold water for a few minutes. Another trick is to sprinkle a little lemon juice or lime juice on the cut side to slow down browning. Store the whole avocado in the fridge if you won’t use it soon.

say: How do I reset a tripped breaker?
text: To reset a tripped breaker, first turn off all the lights and appliances in the affected area. Then, locate the breaker box, flip the tripped breaker to the off position, and then turn it back on. Make sure nothing else is using too much power that could cause it to trip again.

say: What's the safest way to thaw frozen chicken?
text: The safest way to thaw frozen chicken is to place it in a leak-proof plastic bag and submerge it in cold water, changing the water every 30 minutes. You can also thaw it in the refrigerator overnight, which is the slowest but safest method. Avoid thawing at room temperature to prevent bacterial growth.
